companies.name: ナショナル・ストレージ・アフィリエイツ

relations.text: Public Storageとの経営統合(買収)案件を2026年3月に発表
relations.text_en: Announced a proposed business combination with Public Storage in March 2026

source.label: Public Storage 8-K添付(2026年3月)
source.quote: Each of NSA and Public Storage may also file other relevant documents with the SEC regarding the proposed transaction.

relations.text: NSAが10-Kで、競合の上場REITとしてPublic Storageを挙げる
relations.text_en: NSA names Public Storage among competing public self-storage REITs

source.label: National Storage Affiliates Trust 10-K(2026年提出)
source.quote: as well as the other public self storage REITs, including Public Storage, CubeSmart, and Extra Space Storage Inc.

relations.text: 2023年、BREIT傘下のトランクルーム会社Simply Storageを22億ドルで買収
relations.text_en: Bought BREIT's Simply Storage for $2.2 billion in cash in 2023

source.label: Public Storage 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: During 2023, we acquired BREIT Simply Storage LLC ("Simply"), a self-storage company that owned and operated 127 self-storage facilities

companies.name: エクストラ・スペース・ストレージ

relations.text: Extra Spaceが10-Kで、主な競合の上場REITとしてPublic Storageを挙げる
relations.text_en: Extra Space names Public Storage among its three primary public self-storage REIT competitors

source.label: Extra Space Storage 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: Our three primary competitors who are public self-storage REITs are CubeSmart, National Storage Affiliates and Public Storage.

relations.text: CubeSmartが10-Kで、主な競合としてPublic Storageを挙げる
relations.text_en: CubeSmart names Public Storage among its key competitors

source.label: CubeSmart 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: other public self-storage REITs, including, but not limited to, Public Storage, Extra Space Storage Inc., and National Storage Affiliates Trust.

companies.name: U-Haul

relations.text: U-Haulが10-Kで、トランクルームの最大の競合としてPublic Storageを挙げる

source.label: U-Haul Holding 10-K(2026年提出)
source.quote: Our largest competitors in the self-storage market are Public Storage Inc., CubeSmart, and Extra Space Storage, Inc.
